summary: The proposal introduces a WIRE logical type for Parquet that stores serialized wire-format messages as opaque bytes while enabling selective shredding of frequently queried fields. Participants also debate relaxing the finite element restriction, permitting all IEEE 754 values or delegating constraints to higher layers. The results highlight that gains shrink when measured against highly optimized existing code and that adopting a new layout adds complexity to writers. The discussion centers on creating a higher‑level document that compares several numeric encodings—DELTA_BINARY_PACKED, PFOR, FastLanes, and potential optimizations—across speed, storage efficiency, and development effort.
